options.name: label
options.description: Visible title and accessible name of the discussion.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments: { id, parentId, author: { id, name, avatar? }, text, mentions?, createdAt, editedAt?, deleted?, replyCount? }.

options.name: currentUser
options.description: The signed-in user; null makes the discussion read-only (no composer, no reply).

options.name: maxLength
options.description: Maximum characters per comment (1..100000); longer text is blocked from posting, not truncated.

options.name: showCounter
options.description: Show the character counter on every composer; requires maxLength.

options.name: triggers
options.default: @ suggesting the people in the discussion
options.description: Mention triggers and providers of every composer (Mention Input).

options.name: allowReplies
options.description: Show Reply on comments.

options.name: canEdit
options.description: Whether the current user may edit a comment (deleted comments never).

options.name: canDelete
options.description: Whether the current user may delete a comment.

options.name: loadReplies
options.type: ((comment: DiscussionComment, context: DiscussionLoadContext) => Promise<readonly DiscussionComment[]>) | null
options.description: Loads replies of a comment whose replyCount exceeds its loaded replies; context { signal, loaded }.

options.name: status
options.description: loading shows a spinner, error a message with Retry (aui-retry).

options.name: errorText
options.description: Message shown with status error.

options.name: emptyTitle
options.description: Empty state title.

options.name: emptyDescription
options.description: Empty state description.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Placeholder of the new-comment box.

options.name: rows
options.description: Rows of every composer (1..20).

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Names holidays and non-working days in absolute dates.

options.name: now
options.description: Reference time of relative timestamps; default now, refreshed every minute.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: sort
options.description: Order of top-level comments (replies are always oldest first).

options.name: maxIndent
options.description: Levels that indent (1..10); deeper replies show Replying to <name>.

options.name: collapseDepth
options.description: Replies of comments at this depth or deeper start collapsed (1..50; top-level is depth 0).

options.name: pageSize
options.description: Top-level comments shown at first and per Show more comments (1..500).

options.name: repliesPageSize
options.description: Replies shown per thread at first and per Show more replies (1..200).

options.name: showAvatars
options.description: Show avatars.

options.name: headingLevel
options.description: Heading level of the title (2..6).

options.name: composerPosition
options.description: Where the new-comment box sits.

options.name: timezone
options.description: IANA timezone of timestamps.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of labels, numbers, and dates.

properties.name: comments
properties.description: Every comment in the model (frozen copies), including deleted placeholders.

properties.name: composer
properties.description: The new-comment box, or null without a current user.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Add a comment or replace the one with the same id; comments by others are announced.

methods.name: removeComment
methods.description: Remove a comment (no event): a placeholder when it has replies, otherwise gone with deleted ancestors left without replies.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Show a thread's replies (loading them when needed).

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Open and focus the reply box of a comment.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the new-comment box (or the first comment when read-only).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort loads; remove rendering, listeners, timers, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-post
events.description: A top-level comment was posted: { comment }; prevent it to add nothing and keep the text.

events.name: aui-reply
events.description: A reply was posted: { comment, parent }.

events.name: aui-edit
events.description: An edit was saved: { id, text, mentions, previous }; prevent it to keep the previous text.

events.name: aui-delete
events.description: A delete was confirmed: { comment, placeholder } (placeholder: the comment has replies and stays as deleted).

events.name: aui-expand
events.description: A thread was expanded or collapsed: { id, expanded }.

events.name: aui-sort
events.description: The user changed the sort order: { sort }.

events.name: aui-mention
events.description: From the composers (Mention Input): a mention was inserted: { mention }.

contentAreas.name: comments[].text
contentAreas.description: Plain text (never HTML); mentions render as chips and http(s) URLs as links.

cssClasses.name: aui-discussion__header | __heading | __title | __count | __sort
cssClasses.description: Title, comment count, and sort toggle group.

cssClasses.name: aui-discussion__status | __status--error | __status-text | __retry | __empty | __more
cssClasses.description: Loading and error states, empty state, Show more comments.

cssClasses.name: aui-discussion__thread | __replies | __replies--flat | __item | __item--deep
cssClasses.description: Nested lists of comments; --flat stops the indentation.

cssClasses.name: aui-discussion__meta | __author | __replying | __time | __time-relative | __time-absolute | __time--dismissed | __edited
cssClasses.description: Author, replying-to, timestamp with its tooltip, edited marker.

cssClasses.name: aui-discussion__slot | __inline | __inline--reply | --edit | __cancel | __submit | __confirm | __confirm-text | __confirm-delete | __confirm-cancel
cssClasses.description: Reply and edit boxes and the delete confirmation.

cssClasses.name: aui-discussion__toggle | __extra | __extra-error | __more-replies
cssClasses.description: Show or hide replies, more replies, loading and error rows.
